release_name: Live TV v3.5 — Native macOS Picture-in-Picture & Stability
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: Fixed Picture-in-Picture on macOS: Native borderless floating mini-player pinned to corner across all Spaces & apps
On-hover PiP controls: Quick restore back to full player (P), live channel title, play/pause, next/prev, and mute
Direct window dragging in PiP mode without window borders
Fixed TV Remote microserver HTTP header parsing and live connectivity
📱 Phone as TV Remote: Scan QR code on your Mac to control channels & DVR wirelessly from any smartphone
📊 Broadcast Diagnostics HUD: Real-time 'Stats for Nerds' telemetry (Shortcut I)
🎚️ Pro Audio Equalizer: 5 acoustic presets (Normal, Stadium Sports, Dialogue Clarity, Night Mode, Music)
⏱️ Bedtime Sleep Timer: 15 to 120-min countdown with gentle 2-minute linear audio ramp-down
➕ Custom Stream & M3U Importer with persistent local storage
⚡ One-Click Native In-App Auto-Updater with live progress and automatic relaunch
Added Discovery Bangla, Discovery Kids Bangla, Discovery Science HD, Discovery Turbo HD
2,989 total live channels with 3-server instant auto-failover
